1.consolidated_definition: Se dice de la gente de medio pelo. (Proviene de la acepción general: cosa de inferior calidad, hecha sin esmero).
1.en_consolidated_definition: This term refers to people of middle class or lower-middle-class status. (Derives from the general sense: something of inferior quality, made without effort.)
